name: Hotel Edelweiß
beschreibung: The Hotel Edelweiß is located in an alpine environment in Tirol, Österreich and serves as a base for nature and mountain sports activities. The surrounding mountain world is accessible in summer via a network of hiking trails, and in winter via nearby ski areas. The atmosphere of the house is characterized by a traditional, Alpine-style design. The furnishings of the rooms include furniture made of local wood and bathrooms with natural stone. A wellness area with sauna and steam bath is available to guests. The restaurant offers a menu with regional products. Guests can expect accommodation designed for relaxation and sporting activities in the mountain landscape of Tirol.
